narrative.details:
With the Ahn'Qiraj War looming we need to do everything that we can to see to it that our soldiers have everything that they need. We're doing just that right here. For my part I've been placed in charge of seeing to it that we collect enough silk bandages.

Do you think you can help me out, champion?
narrative.objectives: Bring 20 Silk Bandages to Nurse Stonefield at the Military Ward in Ironforge.
narrative.offerRewardText: This Nightscape equipment you have supplied fills the order perfectly, adventurer. I expect no less from a leatherworker of your caliber.You have definitely earned this pattern. I give it to you freely, and hope you will profit from it accordingly.
narrative.requestItemsText: I need those tunics and headbands made, and I also need that piece of wildvine before I will share with you the knowledge of Wild Leather helmets.Head gear is highly coveted amongst adventurers, whether it be a disarmingly simple headband or a full-covering helmet. The fundamentals of creating valued head gear remain constant, no matter what the cosmetic appearance of the gear is.
